learnings.statement: Benchmark probe: RuleStore lists active rules scoped by repository path.
Benchmark probe: The API serves on 127.0.0.1:8000; 0.0.0.0 binding is disabled by policy.
Benchmark probe: Benchmark result JSONs are gitignored under eval/*/results/.
Benchmark probe: The /ask system prompt forces answers in the question's language.
Benchmark probe: Native git push from this VM is impossible; use the GitHub API via the skill.
Benchmark probe: G1 dedup uses cosine similarity with threshold 0.85 — pairs above 0.85 are linked as duplicates.
Benchmark probe: DecisionStore keeps decisions with NULL repo_path as cross-project.
Benchmark probe: Impact analysis fast mode skips LLM calls: ~1s vs ~4min for full mode.
Benchmark probe: nv-embedcode has a ~1k token per-request limit; long texts are truncated.
Benchmark probe: Confidence scores are clamped to [0,1]; out-of-range values are normalized.
Benchmark probe: Failed validations are not integrated into the memory pipeline yet.
Benchmark probe: VM replacements wipe /home/postgres; pgdata survives in ~/workspace.
Benchmark probe: Thinking blocks (<think>, numbered chain-of-thought) are stripped from /ask answers.
Benchmark probe: The daily backup cron runs at 03:38 EEST and keeps 7 days of pg_dump archives.
Benchmark probe: Vercel deploys from master; feature branches use preview URLs.
Benchmark probe: The web UI is a Next.js app under apps/web; API types are generated.
Benchmark probe: Context packs are capped at 14000 tokens; sections beyond budget are excluded.
Benchmark probe: MCP proxy client timeout is shorter than unbounded LLM answers; cap generation tokens.
Benchmark probe: MemoryHandoff events are not ingested into consolidation.
Benchmark probe: Postgres runs on port 5433 in docker compose; the default 5432 is taken by another service.
Benchmark probe: The user prefers concise Russian-language summaries with facts and dates.
Benchmark probe: Harness benchmark review tasks need a clean git worktree or they refuse to run.
Benchmark probe: There is no memory_consolidation_runs ledger; reruns may re-read old episodes.
Benchmark probe: a paraphrase scoring 0.90 similarity is caught by G1; an unrelated pair at 0.10 passes through.
Benchmark probe: Threads drafts need explicit approval before publishing.
Benchmark probe: The worker pool status is exposed via /jobs/worker-status.
Benchmark probe: Reindex after changing embedding models; stored vectors become inconsistent.
Benchmark probe: The background Muse process works on /impact noise; its commits are signed 'Muse <muse@local>'.
Benchmark probe: pgvector was built from source; the apt package was too old.
Benchmark probe: Instagram banner is blocked by region_unavailable in Cyprus.
Benchmark probe: the G1 threshold was calibrated on 7 paraphrase pairs; 0.85 catches real paraphrases without false positives.
Benchmark probe: Token-budget integration for learnings in context packs is not implemented.
Benchmark probe: G3 contradiction check stays fail-open when the LLM errors.
Benchmark probe: Nothing is pushed to GitHub without explicit approval per change.
Benchmark probe: ASK_MAX_ANSWER_TOKENS is 1200; lower values truncated answers mid-sentence.
Benchmark probe: G1 threshold 0.85 was chosen because unrelated pairs score 0.01-0.12 and paraphrases 0.79-0.96.
Benchmark probe: G1 dedup embeddings are precomputed at write time and stored in pgvector for fast query-time ranking.
Benchmark probe: Neo4j browser is available at http://localhost:7474 with default credentials.
Benchmark probe: The /context endpoint returns stale_blocked when the index lags behind HEAD.
Benchmark probe: CI benchmark baseline needs calibration after several real runs.
Benchmark probe: NVIDIA API key lives only in .env; never paste it into chat or logs.
Benchmark probe: Processed markers for L1 events do not exist yet.
Benchmark probe: /tmp is a 512MB tmpfs; heavy npm installs go under ~/workspace/scratch/.
Benchmark probe: Diff-review LLM responses must be parsed with _parse_llm_json_response.
Benchmark probe: Consolidation runs under a Postgres advisory lock; concurrent runs return 'skipped'.
Benchmark probe: Learning statements must be non-empty; empty strings are rejected at write time.
Benchmark probe: The memory benchmark replants its probe learning on every run, then deletes it.
Benchmark probe: Redis persistence is disabled; all queue state is ephemeral and rebuilt on restart.
Benchmark probe: The Telegram bridge polls every 30s; webhooks are not supported behind NAT.
Benchmark probe: The skill-creator skill scaffolds new workspace skills under ~/workspace/skills/.

learning_statement: Benchmark probe: G1 dedup uses cosine similarity with threshold 0.85 — pairs above 0.85 are linked as duplicates.
question: What similarity threshold does G1 dedup use, and how was it chosen?

provenance.note: Many-learnings task: plant ALL 50 learnings (45 irrelevant + 5 relevant about G1 dedup). The question is answerable only from the 5 relevant ones. Checks that must_mention phrases appear in learnings_used and that at least min_relevant_in_learnings_used relevant learnings surface. Requires run_memory to support the 'learnings' array and plant all entries.
